description: 10 benchmark clips of about 10 seconds each (Windows text-to-speech, 16 kHz mono WAV). The same 10 clips are used for the Reading, Repeat, Q&A and Story Telling sections; 'text' is what is spoken and doubles as the expected text for Reading / Repeat. Re-create the audio with benchmark_audio/make_benchmark_audio.ps1.

items.text: Every morning I wake up early, drink a glass of water, and walk to the park near my house, where I meet my friends and talk.
items.question: Describe your daily morning routine.
items.story_prompt: Tell a story about a memorable morning in your life.

items.text: My favorite subject at school is science, because we do exciting experiments in the laboratory and I learn how things work in the world.
items.question: What is your favorite subject at school and why?
items.story_prompt: Tell a story about a science experiment that went wrong.

items.text: Last summer my family travelled to a small village near the mountains, where we swam in a clear river and ate fresh fruit every day.
items.question: Tell me about a trip you enjoyed with your family.
items.story_prompt: Tell a story about a holiday that you will never forget.

items.text: Reading books helps me relax after a long day, and it also improves my vocabulary, my imagination, and my understanding of other people.
items.question: Why do you think reading books is important?
items.story_prompt: Tell a story about a book that changed the way you think.

items.text: In my town there is a busy market where farmers sell vegetables, spices, and flowers, and the whole street smells wonderful on Sunday mornings.
items.question: Describe a place in your town that you like to visit.
items.story_prompt: Tell a story about a day at a busy market.

items.text: When I was ten years old I learned to ride a bicycle, and although I fell down many times, my father never let me give up.
items.question: Tell me about something difficult that you learned to do.
items.story_prompt: Tell a story about a time you learned something new.

items.text: Technology has changed the way students study, because they can watch lessons online, search for answers quickly, and talk to teachers from anywhere.
items.question: How has technology changed the way students learn?
items.story_prompt: Tell a story about a day without any technology.

items.text: Our cricket team practises every evening after school, and last month we won the district final by playing carefully and helping each other.
items.question: Do you enjoy playing a sport? Tell me about it.
items.story_prompt: Tell a story about a match or a game that you remember.

items.text: I want to become a doctor one day, so I study hard, listen carefully to my teachers, and spend my weekends volunteering at a small clinic.
items.question: What do you want to be in the future and how will you achieve it?
items.story_prompt: Tell a story about a person who helped you.

items.text: The festival of lights is my favorite celebration, because the houses shine with lamps, families cook delicious sweets together, and everyone shares gifts and smiles.
items.question: Describe a festival that is special to you.
items.story_prompt: Tell a story about a celebration with your neighbours.
